title: Source who has been inside S4

tellings.quote: I've actually I've I've talked to one person who has been to S4

plain: There is said to be a secret facility called S4 near Papoose Lake in Nevada, and UAPGerb, an online researcher of UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), tells Michels he has talked to one person who has been there. He does not name that person or say what they told him. If the claim holds, it would mean the hidden site is real and people have worked inside it.
